definitions.annotation_count: Number of assumption annotations written for the covered statistical functions (RQ1). Paper: 26 annotations for 18 assumptions (12 Python + 14 R).
definitions.unconfirmed_assumption_warning_rate: Fraction of annotated-function calls (or call sites) where at least one assumption check rejects at α=0.05 (RQ2). Higher indicates more unconfirmed assumptions.
definitions.potential_misuse_call_site_rate: Fraction of unique call sites with ≥1 unconfirmed assumption (potential misuse).
definitions.significant_misuse_rate: Among hypothesis-test calls with unconfirmed assumptions, fraction where a more appropriate alternative test yields a p-value on the opposite side of α vs the original test (different conclusion) (RQ3).
definitions.runtime_overhead_factor: mean(time_with_checks) / mean(time_without_checks) on synthetic samples (e.g., length 100).
definitions.potential_misuse_call_sites: Raw count of unique call sites with ≥1 unconfirmed assumption.
definitions.significant_misuse_calls: Raw count of significant-misuse calls among hypothesis tests.
definitions.notebooks_with_unconfirmed_assumptions: Number of notebooks with ≥1 unconfirmed assumption.
definitions.notebooks_checked: Number of notebooks successfully executed with checks enabled.

reporting_format.note: Report at both call-site and call (invocation) granularity when possible; also report per-function breakdown.

evaluation_script_hint: Monkey-patch annotated scipy.stats / R stats functions at notebook top (warnings only), execute with nbclient/nbconvert or Rscript, parse warnings, then for unconfirmed hypothesis tests re-run the appropriate non-parametric alternative and compare p-values against α.
